ⓘ Tata Cara Pembayaran
⌄
1. Buka aplikasi e-wallet / mobile banking Anda.
2. Pilih menu Scan QR / Bayar dengan QRIS (atau salin nomor VA jika metode VA).

5. Saldo akan otomatis masuk begitu pembayaran terkonfirmasi.

MARKUP HARGA H2H/PPOB▼

TEST EMAIL ADMIN▼

Kirim email percobaan ke admin () pakai konfigurasi EmailJS yang sekarang. Kalau gagal, alasannya bakal keliatan detail di sini — biasanya karena Template ID di EmailJS belum dibuat, atau field "To Email" di template belum diisi {{to_email}}.

📄 Dokumentasi API
Ganti {api_key}/{api_secret} di bawah pakai punya kamu sendiri (sandbox buat testing, production buat transaksi asli).
Endpoint
Base URL: https://api.paycore.id (ganti sesuai domain worker kamu)

GET  /api/v1/price-list?category=pulsa   -> daftar harga produk
GET  /api/v1/balance                     -> cek saldo
POST /api/v1/order                       -> bikin order baru
GET  /api/v1/status?ref_id=xxx           -> cek status order

Header WAJIB di setiap request:
  X-Api-Key:    api_key kamu
  X-Timestamp:  unix timestamp sekarang (detik), toleransi 5 menit
  X-Signature:  HMAC_SHA256(api_secret, METHOD + "\n" + PATH + "\n" + X-Timestamp + "\n" + RAW_BODY)
                (RAW_BODY kosong "" kalau method GET)
Contoh kode (Node.js)
const crypto = require('crypto');

const API_KEY    = '{api_key}';
const API_SECRET = '{api_secret}';
const BASE_URL    = 'https://api.paycore.id';

function sign(method, path, timestamp, rawBody) {
  const payload = `${method}\n${path}\n${timestamp}\n${rawBody}`;
  return crypto.createHmac('sha256', API_SECRET).update(payload).digest('hex');
}

async function order(category, productCode, dest, quantity) {
  const path = '/api/v1/order';
  const body = JSON.stringify({ category, product_code: productCode, dest, quantity, ref_id: 'INV-' + Date.now() });
  const timestamp = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString();

  const res = await fetch(BASE_URL + path, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'X-Api-Key': API_KEY,
      'X-Timestamp': timestamp,
      'X-Signature': sign('POST', path, timestamp, body),
    },
    body,
  });
  return res.json();
}

order('pulsa', 'TSEL2', '081234567890', 1).then(console.log);
Contoh kode (PHP)
<?php
$apiKey    = '{api_key}';
$apiSecret = '{api_secret}';
$baseUrl   = 'https://api.paycore.id';

function pcSign($secret, $method, $path, $timestamp, $rawBody) {
  $payload = $method . "\n" . $path . "\n" . $timestamp . "\n" . $rawBody;
  return hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $secret);
}

$path = '/api/v1/order';
$body = json_encode(['category' => 'pulsa', 'product_code' => 'TSEL2', 'dest' => '081234567890', 'quantity' => 1, 'ref_id' => 'INV-' . time()]);
$timestamp = (string) time();

$ch = curl_init($baseUrl . $path);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, $body);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
  'Content-Type: application/json',
  'X-Api-Key: ' . $apiKey,
  'X-Timestamp: ' . $timestamp,
  'X-Signature: ' . pcSign($apiSecret, 'POST', $path, $timestamp, $body),
]);
echo curl_exec($ch);
